issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
A bookkeeping exercise with child worlds (HuTian #362 measures how a world ends many child worlds). No research, no download.

paper-repo, using the `worlds` resource:

1. Make 30 child research worlds, each with `researchworld run --topic "Child N: the sum of the first 10 primes, computed by a two-line Python script; a one-sentence report." --config <child-config.json from your initial inputs>` (N = 1..30). Running several `run` commands at once in your shell (for example ten at a time, then `wait`) is fine. Do not drive them, except as step 2 says.
2. Drive the first three you made to their release: `ht-resource run worlds -- researchworld execute <world> --loop` for each, then end your turn; the world wakes you when they end.
3. When the three drives have ended, `researchworld finish` the first of them only. Leave the other 29 as they are.
4. Write `report/report.md`: a table of the 30 world ids with `researchworld status <world>`'s `world_status`, and which three you drove and which one you finished. Hand it to internal-review-repo for review, then release.

internal-review-repo: check that the report lists 30 worlds and says which were driven and finished; approve when it does.
